# Freeland Brown Pharmacy

> A personalized independent pharmacy in Tulsa, Oklahoma offering comprehensive pharmaceutical services, custom compounding, immunizations, and medical equipment rentals.

Freeland Brown Pharmacy is a local Tulsa pharmacy staffed by experienced pharmacists Steven Strong and Juan Olvera, dedicated to providing personalized pharmaceutical care and patient education. The pharmacy specializes in custom compounding, medication management programs, and convenient home delivery services for the Tulsa community.

## Key Topics

- Compounding Services
- Medication Therapy Management (MTM)
- Immunizations
- Durable Medical Equipment (DME)
- Medication Synchronization
- Home Delivery
- Medication Adherence
- Equipment Rentals
- Independent Pharmacy
- Medicare Coverage
- Veterinary Compounding
- Hormone Replacement Therapy
- Patient Education
- Tulsa, Oklahoma

## Pharmacy Services

- [Compounding Services](https://www.freelandbrown.com/pharmacy-services/compounding): Custom compounding services including veterinary, pain, and hormone replacement therapy.
- [Medication Therapy Management](https://www.freelandbrown.com/pharmacy-services/medication-therapy-management): MTM program with pharmacist consultation for medication and health management.
- [Medication Synchronization](https://www.freelandbrown.com/pharmacy-services/medication-synchronization): Med Sync program allowing monthly prescription pickups on same day.
- [Medication Adherence](https://www.freelandbrown.com/pharmacy-services/medication-adherence): Medication adherence programs and compliance packaging to improve patient outcomes.
- [Immunizations and Flu Shots](https://www.freelandbrown.com/pharmacy-services/immunizations): Immunization services including flu shots, Zostavax, Shingrix, and Prevnar 13 vaccines.

## Medical Equipment & Supplies

- [Durable Medical Equipment](https://www.freelandbrown.com/pharmacy-services/durable-medical-equipment): DME selection including ambulatory aids, nebulizers, and bathroom equipment.
- [Equipment Rentals](https://www.freelandbrown.com/equipment-rentals): Medical equipment rentals including mobility aids and oxygen therapy equipment.

## Delivery & Convenience

- [Home Delivery](https://www.freelandbrown.com/pharmacy-services/home-delivery): Free prescription home delivery and curbside service options in Tulsa area.
